brief.suggested_title: AI Visibility: How to Get Your Brand Cited by ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini
brief.answer_first: AI visibility is how often answer engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini cite your brand in their responses. You improve it by structuring pages answer-first, adding citable claims and schema, and clarifying entity and freshness signals.
outline: What "AI visibility" means and why it's the new SEO

How to structure a page answer-first
